text:
Riley M.: Pushed a fresh variant for the latency panel: p95 as a thin header row above the heatmap, compact time picker left, display controls in a "Display" panel. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abc-latency-panel
Nora S.: Looks clean. Header row avoids overlay collisions with scrubber. Concern: vertical space on small dashboards. Suggest collapse rules at <= 800px.
Ethan V.: Agree on collapse. Also: when heat levels are dense, the p95 line can be lost. Proposal: p95 uses a faint glow (outline) instead of thick stroke at high density.
Priya: Microcopy: change tooltip from "p95 latency" to "p95 latency (95th percentile)" for first-time users.
Leo G.: Accessibility: dashed connectors may fail contrast checks. Use a small filled caret behind the p95 label instead. I'll add color tokens that meet 4.5:1.
Riley M.: For the time picker, keep presets first, then custom range, then bucket control. Keyboard tab order must follow that visual order.
Nora S.: Rename "Aggregation" to "Bucket size" in UI and help text. Tooltip: "Size of each heatmap bucket (larger = coarser)". Add aria-describedby to link the control to help text.
Ethan V.: Perf note: live re-binning during slider drag is expensive. Debounce to 300ms and show skeleton shimmer while recalculating. For fast scrubber drags, throttle p95 redraws to maintain 60fps.
Priya: QA checklist: keyboard-only flow to open Display, toggle heatmap, and edit Bucket size. Add step-by-step in the ticket.
ux-bot: Reminder: add storybook examples for header p95 + heatmap off. Tag: @riley-m for component variants.
Leo G.: Also add a colorblind-friendly sequential palette (deuteranopia-friendly). I'll drop swatches in the figma.
Riley M.: Decision summary: 1) p95 in header row on desktop, overlay fallback on mobile; 2) rename to "Bucket size"; 3) Display panel label; 4) heatmap toggle and keyboard QA steps; 5) 300ms debounce + shimmer. I'll update handoff doc and post ARIA examples in the dev ticket.
Nora S.: I'll draft the accessibility notes and responsive collapse rules.
Ethan V.: I'll prototype the throttling and add perf test ticket.
Priya: I'll update help center copy and tooltip strings.
Riley M.: Thanks team :thumbsup: I'll upload final frames and the ARIA snippet.
